rawFindings.title: Potential crash when VariableDeclaration has no declarations
rawFindings.explanation: The reducer uses the first element `node.declarations[0]` as the initial value without checking if the declarations array is empty. If the VariableDeclaration has zero declarators, accessing `node.declarations[0]` will be undefined, leading to a runtime error when attempting to access `memo.id.name` in the reducer.
rawFindings.suggestion:
Add a guard clause before the reduce call to check if `node.declarations` is non-empty. For example:

```js
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Parsing a file with an empty variable declaration like `var;` or `var /* no declarators */ ;` triggers a crash due to accessing properties of undefined memo in the reduce call.
